title: 1954 AHSME Problem 33
statement: A bank charges \(\$6\) for a loan of \(\$120.\) The borrower receives \(\$114\) and repays the loan in \(12\) installments of \(\$10\) a month. The interest rate is approximately:

solutions.text:
The balance decreases in equal \(\$10\) steps from \(\$120\) to \(\$10,\) so its average outstanding value is approximately \[ \frac{120+10}{2}=65. \] The annual charge is therefore about \[ \frac6{65}\cdot100\%\approx9.2\%. \] The nearest choice is \(9\%.\)

Thus, the correct answer is D.
hints: The \(\$6\) charge is interest on a balance that decreases by \(\$10\) each month
Approximate the average outstanding principal by the average of \(\$120\) and \(\$10\)
